e: And Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying;

t: קַבֵּל יָת חֻשְׁבַּן בְּנֵי גֵרְשׁוֹן אַף אִנּוּן
e: Take the count of the sons of Gershon as well,
according to the house of their fathers according to their families.

h: מִבֶּן֩ שְׁלֹשִׁ֨ים שָׁנָ֜ה וָמַ֗עְלָה עַ֛ד בֶּן־חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה תִּפְקֹ֣ד אוֹתָ֑ם
t: מִבַּר תְּלָתִין שְׁנִין וּלְעֵלָּא עַד בַּר חַמְשִׁין שְׁנִין תִּמְנֵי יָתְהוֹן
e: From thirty years and above, until fifty years, you shall count them;
all those who enter the division
to serve in the Tent of Meeting.
This is the service of
the families of the Gershonites
to serve, and to carry.

t: וְיִטְּלוּן יָת יְרִיעַת מַשְׁכְּנָא וְיָת מַשְׁכַּן זִמְנָא
חוֹפָאֵיהּ וְחוֹפָאָה דְסַסְגּוֹנָא דִּי עֲלוֹהִי מִלְּעֵלָּא
e: They shall carry the tapestries of the Mishkon and [of] the Tent of Meeting,
its covering and the covering of tachash which is on top of it,
and the screen for the entrance to the Tent of Meeting,

h: וְאֵת֩ קַלְעֵ֨י הֶֽחָצֵ֜ר וְאֶת־מָסַ֣ךְ פֶּ֣תַח שַׁ֣עַר הֶחָצֵ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר עַל־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֤ן וְעַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ סָבִ֔יב
t: וְיָת סְרָדֵי דַרְתָּא וְיָת פְּרָסָא דְמַעֲלָנָא דִּתְרַע דַּרְתָּא דִּי עַל מַשְׁכְּנָא וְעַל מַדְבְּחָא סְחוֹר סְחוֹר
e: the hanging [tapestries] of the courtyard, the screen for the entrance to the gate of the courtyard which are over the Mishkon and altar on all sides,
their ropes
and all of their service utensils
and all that will be given [delivered] to them, and thus shall they serve.

h: עַל־פִּי֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן וּבָנָ֜יו תִּהְיֶ֗ה כָּל־עֲבֹדַת֙ בְּנֵ֣י הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֔י
t: עַל מֵימַר אַהֲרֹן וּבְנוֹהִי יְהֵי כָּל פָּלְחַן בְּנֵי גֵרְשׁוֹן
e: By instruction of Aharon and [one of] his sons shall be all the services of the sons of the Gershonites
for all that they carry and for all their service.
You shall fix specified appointments for them
for everything they carry.

h: זֹ֣את עֲבֹדַ֗ת מִשְׁפְּחֹ֛ת בְּנֵ֥י הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֖י בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד
t: דֵּין פָּלְחַן זַרְעֲיַת בְּנֵי גֵרְשׁוֹן בְּמַשְׁכַּן זִמְנָא
e: This is the service of the families of the sons of the Gershonites in the Tent of Meeting.
Their guardianship is in the hands of Isamar,
the son of Aharon the kohein.
The sons of Merori,
according to their families and according to the house of their fathers you shall count them.

h: מִבֶּן֩ שְׁלֹשִׁ֨ים שָׁנָ֜ה וָמַ֗עְלָה וְעַ֛ד בֶּן־חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה תִּפְקְדֵ֑ם
t: מִבַּר תְּלָתִין שְׁנִין וּלְעֵלָּא וְעַד בַּר חַמְשִׁין שְׁנִין תִּמְנִנּוּן
e: From thirty years and above until fifty years, you shall count them;
all who enter the division
to serve in the Tent of Meeting.
This is what they are entrusted to carry
according to all their duties in the Tent of Meeting;
the beams of the Mishkon,
its bars, pillars and sockets.

h: וְעַמּוּדֵי֩ הֶחָצֵ֨ר סָבִ֜יב וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֗ם וִֽיתֵדֹתָם֙ וּמֵ֣יתְרֵיהֶ֔ם
t: וְעַמּוּדֵי דְדַרְתָּא סְחוֹר סְחוֹר וְסַמְכֵיהוֹן וְסִכֵּיהוֹן וְאַטּוּנֵיהוֹן
e: The pillars around the courtyard, their sockets, stakes and ropes;
with all their utensils and for all their service;
and by name shall you appoint
the utensils to the charge of those who will carry them.
This is the service of the families of the sons of Merori
for all their service in the Tent of Meeting,
under the direction of Isamar,
the son of Aharon, the kohein.

h: וַיִּפְקֹ֨ד מֹשֶׁ֧ה וְאַהֲרֹ֛ן וּנְשִׂיאֵ֥י הָעֵדָ֖ה אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י הַקְּהָתִ֑י
t: וּמְנָא משֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן וְרַבְרְבֵי כְנִשְׁתָּא יָת בְּנֵי קְהָת
e: They counted — Moshe, Aharon and the leaders of the congregation — the sons of the Kehosites
according to their families and according to the house of their fathers.
Those, from thirty years and above,
until fifty years;
all those who enter the division
to serve in the Tent of Meeting.
Their numbers, according to their families
were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.
These are the numbers of the families of the Kehosites
of all who serve in the Tent of Meeting
whom Moshe and Aharon counted
according to the word of Adonoy, through Moshe.
The numbers of the sons of Gershon,
according to their families and according to the house of their fathers.
Those, from thirty years and above,
until fifty years;
all who enter the division
to serve in the Tent of Meeting.
Their numbers,
according to their families, according to the house of their fathers
were two thousand six hundred and thirty.

h: אֲשֶׁ֨ר פָּקַ֥ד מֹשֶׁ֛ה וְאַהֲרֹ֖ן עַל־פִּ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
t: דִּי מְנָא משֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן עַל מֵימְרָא דַיְיָ:
e: These are the numbers of the families of the sons of the Gershonites,
of all those who serve in the Tent of Meeting,
whom Moshe and Aharon counted, according to the word of Adonoy.
The numbers of the families of the sons of the Merorites
according to their families, according to the house of their fathers.
Those, from thirty years and above,
until fifty years;
all who enter the division
to serve in the Tent of Meeting.
Their numbers were, according to their families,
three thousand two hundred.
These are the numbers
of the families of the sons of the Merorites
whom Moshe and Aharon counted
according to the word of Adonoy, through Moshe.

h: כָּֽל־הַפְּקֻדִ֡ים אֲשֶׁר֩ פָּקַ֨ד מֹשֶׁ֧ה וְאַהֲרֹ֛ן וּנְשִׂיאֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶת־הַלְוִיִּ֑ם
t: כָּל מִנְיָנַיָּא דִּי מְנָא משֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן וְרַבְרְבֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יָת לֵוָאֵי
e: The total of the numbers counted by Moshe, Aharon and the leaders of the congregation [of] the Levites according to their families,
according to the house of their fathers.

h: כָּל־הַבָּ֗א לַעֲבֹ֨ד עֲבֹדַ֧ת עֲבֹדָ֛ה וַעֲבֹדַ֥ת מַשָּׂ֖א בְּאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
t: כָּל דְּאָתֵי לְמִפְלַח פָּלְחַן פָּלְחָנָא וּפָלְחַן מַטּוּל בְּמַשְׁכַּן זִמְנָא:
e: Those from thirty years and above,
until fifty years;
all who enter to serve the service of service and the service of carrying in the Tent of Meeting.
Their numbers were
eight thousand
five hundred and eighty.

t: עַל מֵימְרָא דַיְיָ מְנָא יָתְהוֹן בִּידָא דְמשֶׁה
גְּבַר גְּבַר עַל פָּלְחָנֵיהּ וְעַל מַטּוּלֵיהּ
וּמִנְיָנוֹהִי דִּי פַקִּיד יְיָ יָת משֶׁה:
e: According to the word of Adonoy he counted them, by the hand of Moshe,
each man according to his service and according to what he carries;
and they were counted, as Adonoy commanded Moshe.
Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying;
Command Bnei Yisroel
that they must expel from the camp.
anyone with tzora’as, and anyone from whom flows a [seminal] discharge
and anyone who became defiled by a (departed) [the bones of the] soul [of a person].
Whether male or female you shall send them out.
Beyond the camp you shall send them,
and they shall not defile their camps
in which I dwell [My Shechina dwells] among them.

t: כְּמָא דִּי מַלִּיל יְיָ עִם משֶׁה
e: Bnei Yisroel did so,
and they sent them
beyond the camp;
just as Adonoy spoke to Moshe,
so did Bnei Yisroel do.
Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying;

h: אִ֣ישׁ אֽוֹ־אִשָּׁ֗ה כִּ֤י יַעֲשׂוּ֙ מִכָּל־חַטֹּ֣את הָֽאָדָ֔ם
t: גְּבַר אוֹ אִתְּתָא אֲרֵי יַעְבְּדוּן מִכָּל חוֹבֵי אֱנָשָׁא
e: Speak to Bnei Yisroel:
When a man or a woman commits any of the sins against man,
acting treacherously [untruthfully before] against Adonoy,
and that person is guilty.
They shall confess the sins which they committed
and return the principal amount [of the object] of his guilt,
and add one fifth to that amount.
He shall then give it to whom he is indebted.

h: וְאִם־אֵ֨ין לָאִ֜ישׁ גֹּאֵ֗ל לְהָשִׁ֤יב הָאָשָׁם֙ אֵלָ֔יו
t: וְאִם לֵית לִגְבַר פָּרִיק לַאֲתָבָא חוֹבְתָא לֵיהּ
e: But if the man has no redeemer (relative) to whom the debt may be returned,
the debt being returned then belongs to Adonoy, [then] to the kohein.
This is besides the ram of forgiveness
with which he [his sin] will be atoned.

h: וְכָל־תְּרוּמָ֞ה לְכָל־קָדְשֵׁ֧י בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־יַקְרִ֥יבוּ לַכֹּהֵ֖ן ל֥וֹ יִהְיֶֽה׃
t: וְכָל אַפְרָשׁוּתָא לְכָל קוּדְשַׁיָּא דִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל דִּי יְקָרְבוּן לְכַהֲנָא דִּלֵּיהּ יְהֵא:
e: Every terumah-gift of all the sacred things of Bnei Yisroel that they will bring to the kohein, shall be his.
A [tenth of] man’s sacred objects shall be his;
whatever a man gives to the kohein, shall be his.
Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying;
Speak to Bnei Yisroel
and say to them:
If any man’s wife goes astray
and acts treacherously [untruthfully] toward him.
And a man has lain with her conjugally
but it was hidden [covered] from her husband’s eyes
and she was concealed and has become defiled
and there is no witness against her,
and she was not seized forcibly.

h: וְעָבַ֨ר עָלָ֧יו רֽוּחַ־קִנְאָ֛ה וְקִנֵּ֥א אֶת־אִשְׁתּ֖וֹ וְהִ֣וא נִטְמָ֑אָה
t: וְיֶעְבַּר עֲלוֹהִי רוּחַ קִנְאָה וִיקַנֵּי יָת אִתְּתֵיהּ וְהִיא מְסָאָבָא
אוֹ עֲבַר עֲלוֹהִי רוּחַ קִנְאָה וִיקַנֵּי יָת אִתְּתֵיהּ
e: [When] a spirit of jealousy comes upon him and he is jealous of his wife and she was defiled
or, a spirit of jealousy comes upon him and he is jealous of his wife
and she was not defiled,

h: לֹֽא־יִצֹ֨ק עָלָ֜יו שֶׁ֗מֶן וְלֹֽא־יִתֵּ֤ן עָלָיו֙ לְבֹנָ֔ה
t: וְיַיְתִי גַבְרָא יָת אִתְּתֵיהּ לְוָת כַּהֲנָא
חַד מִן עַסְרָא בִּתְלַת סְאִין קִמְחָא שְׂעָרִין
לָא יְרִיק עֲלוֹהִי מִשְׁחָא וְלָא יִתֵּן עֲלוֹהִי לְבֻנְתָּא
e: that man shall bring his wife to the kohein
and he shall bring her offering for her;
[which is] one tenth of an epha [three se’in] of barley flour;
he shall not pour oil over it and he shall not put frankincense on it,
for it is a meal-offering of jealousy,
a meal-offering of remembrance, recalling an iniquity.
The kohein shall bring her near
and station her before Adonoy.
The kohein shall take sanctified waters [water from the copper wash basin] in a clay utensil,
and of the earth that will be on the floor [base] of the Mishkon,
the kohein shall take and put into the water.

t: וִיקִים כַּהֲנָא יָת אִתְּתָא קֳדָם יְיָ
e: The kohein shall station the woman before Adonoy,
and expose the woman’s hair,
and place on her palms [hands] the meal-offering of remembrance;
it is a meal-offering of jealousy
and there will be in the kohein’s hand,
the bitter, lethal waters.

h: וְהִשְׁבִּ֨יעַ אֹתָ֜הּ הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְאָמַ֤ר אֶל־הָֽאִשָּׁה֙ אִם־לֹ֨א שָׁכַ֥ב אִישׁ֙ אֹתָ֔ךְ
t: וְיוֹמֵי יָתַהּ כַּהֲנָא וְיֵימַר לְאִתְּתָא אִם לָא שְׁכִיב גְּבַר יָתִיךְ
הֱוֵי זַכָּאָה מִמַּיָּא מְרִירַיָּא מְלַטְטַיָּא הָאִלֵּין:
e: The kohein shall place her under oath and say to the woman: If a man has not lain with you [conjugally]
and if you have not gone astray to be defiled while you were married to [by someone other than] your husband,
you shall be absolved of these bitter, lethal waters.

h: וְאַ֗תְּ כִּ֥י שָׂטִ֛ית תַּ֥חַת אִישֵׁ֖ךְ וְכִ֣י נִטְמֵ֑את
t: וְאַתְּ אֲרֵי סְטִית בַּר מִבַּעֲלִיךְ וַאֲרֵי אִסְתָּאָבְתְּ
e: [But] you, if you have gone astray while you were married to your husband, and if you have been defiled,
and if a man has lain conjugally with you,
[a man] other than your husband.

h: יִתֵּ֨ן יְהוָ֥ה אוֹתָ֛ךְ לְאָלָ֥ה וְלִשְׁבֻעָ֖ה בְּת֣וֹךְ עַמֵּ֑ךְ
t: וְיוֹמֵי כַהֲנָא יָת אִתְּתָא בְּמוֹמָתָא דִלְוָטָא
יְהֵב יְיָ יָתִיךְ לִלְוַט וּלְמוֹמֵי בְּגוֹ עַמִּיךְ
e: The kohein shall place the woman under oath with the oath of accursedness,
and the kohein shall say to the woman:
“Adonoy shall make you a curse and an oath among your people,
when Adonoy causes your thigh to collapse [fall away]
and your abdomen to swell.
This bitter, lethal water will enter your abdomen
to swell [inflate] the abdomen, and collapse [fall away] the thigh
and the woman shall say “Amein, Amein”.

t: וְיִכְתּוֹב יָת לְוָטַיָּא הָאִלֵּין כַּהֲנָא בְּסִפְרָא
e: The kohein shall write all these curses, on the scroll
and dissolve them (the writing) in the bitter waters.
He shall have the woman drink
the bitter, lethal waters
and the lethal waters, shall enter her to become bitter.
The kohein shall take from the woman’s hand
the meal-offering of jealousy
and he shall wave the meal-offering before Adonoy,
and bring it close to the Altar.

t: וְיִקְמוֹץ כַּהֲנָא מִן מִנְחָתָא יָת אַדְכַּרְתַּהּ
וּבָתַר כֵּן יַשְׁקֵי יָת אִתְּתָא יָת מַיָּא:
e: The kohein shall scoop out from the meal-offering its commemoration
and burn it on [bring it up to] the Altar,
and after that he shall cause the woman to drink the water.

h: וְהִשְׁקָ֣הּ אֶת־הַמַּ֗יִם וְהָיְתָ֣ה אִֽם־נִטְמְאָה֮ וַתִּמְעֹ֣ל מַ֣עַל בְּאִישָׁהּ֒
t: וְיַשְׁקִנַּהּ יָת מַיָּא וּתְהֵי אִם אִסְתָּאָבַת וְשַׁקָּרַת שְׁקָר בְּבַעֲלַהּ
e: He shall make her drink the water, and it shall be that if she had been defiled and had deceived [been untruthful to] her husband,
the lethal waters shall enter her to become bitter,
and her abdomen will swell
and her thigh will collapse [fall away],
and the woman will be a curse among her people.
But if the woman was not defiled
and [she] is pure,
she will be cleansed [go out exonerated] and shall bear seed [will conceive].

h: אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּשְׂטֶ֥ה אִשָּׁ֛ה תַּ֥חַת אִישָׁ֖הּ וְנִטְמָֽאָה׃
t: דִּי תִסְטֵי אִתְּתָא בַּר מִבַּעֲלַהּ וְתִסְתָּאָב:
e: This is the law of jealousies,
when a woman goes astray during her marriage to her husband and is defiled.

h: א֣וֹ אִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תַּעֲבֹ֥ר עָלָ֛יו ר֥וּחַ קִנְאָ֖ה וְקִנֵּ֣א אֶת־אִשְׁתּ֑וֹ
t: אוֹ גְבַר דִּי תֶעְבַּר עֲלוֹהִי רוּחַ קִנְאָה וִיקַנֵּי יָת אִתְּתֵהּ
e: If a man is overcome with a spirit of jealousy and he is jealous of his wife,
then he shall have the woman stand before Adonoy,
and the kohein shall
do unto her all of these laws.
The man is cleansed [innocent] of sin
and that woman shall
bear [the burden of] her iniquity.
Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying;

h: אִ֣ישׁ אֽוֹ־אִשָּׁ֗ה כִּ֤י יַפְלִא֙ לִנְדֹּר֙ נֶ֣דֶר נָזִ֔יר
t: גְּבַר אוֹ אִתְּתָא אֲרֵי יְפָרֵשׁ לְמִדַּר נְדַר נְזִירוּ
e: Speak to Bnei Yisroel
and say to them:
If a man or a woman sets apart a vow, a nazirite vow,
to set [himself] apart for [from before] Adonoy.

h: חֹ֥מֶץ יַ֛יִן וְחֹ֥מֶץ שֵׁכָ֖ר לֹ֣א יִשְׁתֶּ֑ה
t: חַל דַּחֲמַר חֲדַת וְחַל דַּחֲמַר עַתִּיק לָא יִשְׁתֵּי
e: From new or old [intoxicating] wine, he must abstain.
Vinegar made from new wine and vinegar made from old wine he shall not drink;
anything steeped in grapes he shall not drink;
moist grapes or dried grapes (raisins) he shall not eat.

h: מִכֹּל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יֵעָשֶׂ֜ה מִגֶּ֣פֶן הַיַּ֗יִן מֵחַרְצַנִּ֛ים וְעַד־זָ֖ג לֹ֥א יֹאכֵֽל׃
t: מִכֹּל דְּיִתְעֲבֵד מִגֻּפְנָא דְחַמְרָא מִפּוּרְצְנִין וְעַד עִצּוּרִין לָא יֵיכוּל:
e: As long as he is a Nazir
from anything made of the grape-vine, from seeds to skin, he shall not eat.

h: עַד־מְלֹ֨את הַיָּמִ֜ם אֲשֶׁר־יַזִּ֤יר לַיהוָה֙ קָדֹ֣שׁ יִהְיֶ֔ה
t: עַד מִשְׁלַם יוֹמַיָּא דְּיַנְזֵר קֳדָם יְיָ קַדִּישׁ יְהֵי
e: As long as [all the days] he is under his nazirite oath
a razor shall not pass over [to touch] his head.
Until he completes his days as a Nazir to Adonoy he shall be sacred,
he shall let the hair of his head grow long.
All the days that he is a Nazir to Adonoy,
he shall have no contact with the dead.
For his father, mother, brother and sister
he shall not [ritually] defile himself for them when they die.
For, the nazirite crown of his God is upon his head.
All the days of his separation,
he is sacred to Adonoy.

t: וַאֲרֵי יְמוּת מֵתָא עֲלוֹהִי בִּתְכֵּף שָׁלוּ
e: If someone died near him suddenly, or unexpectedly,
and caused his nazirite crowned head to be defiled,
he shall shave his head on the day of his purification,
he shall shave it on the seventh day.
On the eighth day he shall take two turtledoves
or two young pigeons
to the kohein, to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

h: וְעָשָׂ֣ה הַכֹּהֵ֗ן אֶחָ֤ד לְחַטָּאת֙ וְאֶחָ֣ד לְעֹלָ֔ה
t: וְיַעְבֵּד כַּהֲנָא חַד לְחַטָּאתָא וְחַד לַעֲלָתָא
e: The kohein shall prepare one for a sin-offering and one for a burnt-offering
and atone on his behalf
from his sin [of contact] with a [departed] soul,
and he shall sanctify his head on that day.

t: וְיַזֵּר קֳדָם יְיָ יָת יוֹמֵי נִזְרֵיהּ
e: He shall set apart, for Adonoy, his nazirite days,
and bring a sheep in its first year as a guilt-offering.
The first days shall elapse
because his nazirite crown was defiled.
This is the law of the Nazir:
when the days of his nazirite status are fulfilled,
he shall bring himself
to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

h: וְהִקְרִ֣יב אֶת־קָרְבָּנ֣וֹ לַיהוָ֡ה כֶּבֶשׂ֩ בֶּן־שְׁנָת֨וֹ תָמִ֤ים אֶחָד֙ לְעֹלָ֔ה
t: וִיקָרֵב יָת קֻרְבָּנֵיהּ קֳדָם יְיָ אִמַּר בַּר שַׁתֵּהּ שְׁלִים חַד לַעֲלָתָא
וְאִמַּרְתָּא חֲדָא בַּת שַׁתֵּהּ שְׁלֶמְתָּא לְחַטָּאתָא
e: He shall bring his offering to Adonoy; one unblemished sheep, in its first year, as a burnt-offering,
and one unblemished ewe, in its first year as a sin-offering,
and one unblemished ram as a peace-offering [sacred sacrifice].

h: וְסַ֣ל מַצּ֗וֹת סֹ֤לֶת חַלֹּת֙ בְּלוּלֹ֣ת בַּשֶּׁ֔מֶן
t: וְסַל פַּטִּיר סֻלְתָּא גְרִיצַן דְּפִילָן בִּמְשַׁח
e: A basket of matzos of fine flour, loaves mixed with oil
and matzoh-wafers spread with oil
and their meal-offerings and libations.
The kohein shall bring it before Adonoy
and do the service of his sin-offering and of his burnt-offering.

t: וְיָת דִּכְרָא יַעְבֵּד נִכְסַת קוּדְשַׁיָּא קֳדָם יְיָ
e: He shall make the ram a peace-offering [sacred sacrifice] for Adonoy along
with the basket of matzos,
and the kohein shall
do the service of his meal-offering and libation.

h: וְגִלַּ֣ח הַנָּזִ֗יר פֶּ֛תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד אֶת־רֹ֣אשׁ נִזְר֑וֹ
t: וִיגַלַּח נְזִירָא בִּתְרַע מַשְׁכַּן זִמְנָא יָת רֵישׁ נִזְרֵיהּ
e: The Nazir shall shave — at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting — the nazirite crown of hair on his head,
and he shall take the hair from the nazirite crown on his head
and put it in the fire
which is under the [cauldron of the] peace-offering [sacred] sacrifice.

t: וְיִסַּב כַּהֲנָא יָת דְּרָעָא בְּשֵׁלָא מִן דִּכְרָא
e: The kohein shall take the cooked foreleg from the ram
and one matzoh-loaf from the basket,
and one matzoh-wafer,
and put it on the palms [hands] of the Nazir
after he has shaved his nazirite crown.

h: וְהֵנִיף֩ אוֹתָ֨ם הַכֹּהֵ֥ן תְּנוּפָה֮ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָה֒
t: וִירִים יָתְהוֹן כַּהֲנָא אֲרָמָא קֳדָם יְיָ
e: The kohein shall wave them as a wave-offering, before Adonoy.
It is consecrated to the kohein
besides the breast of the wave-offering
and the separated thigh portion.
After this, the Nazir may drink wine.
This is the law of the Nazir who has vowed —
[this is] his offering to Adonoy for his nazirite vow,
aside from what he can afford [lit. may attach to his hands]
to bring according to his vow that he vows.
So shall he fulfill
in addition to the laws of his nazirite [vows.]
Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying;

t: מַלֵּל עִם אַהֲרֹן וְעִם בְּנוֹהִי לְמֵימַר
e: Speak to Aharon and to his sons, saying;
This is how you shall bless Bnei Yisroel,
saying to them:
May Adonoy bless you and protect you.
May Adonoy cause His countenance [Shechinah] to shine upon you and favor you.
May Adonoy lift His face to you,
and grant you peace.

t: וִישַׁוּוּן יָת בִּרְכַּת שְׁמִי עַל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל
e: They shall bestow [the blessing of] My Name upon Bnei Yisroel,
and I will bless them.

h: וַיְהִ֡י בְּיוֹם֩ כַּלּ֨וֹת מֹשֶׁ֜ה לְהָקִ֣ים אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֗ן וַיִּמְשַׁ֨ח אֹת֜וֹ וַיְקַדֵּ֤שׁ אֹתוֹ֙ וְאֶת־כָּל־כֵּלָ֔יו
t: וַהֲוָה בְּיוֹמָא דְשֵׁיצֵי משֶׁה לַאֲקָמָא יָת מַשְׁכְּנָא וְרַבִּי יָתֵיהּ וְקַדִּישׁ יָתֵיהּ וְיָת כָּל מָנוֹהִי
e: It came to pass, on the day Moshe finished erecting the Mishkon, and he anointed it and consecrated it and all of its utensils,
and the Altar and all its utensils,
and he anointed them and consecrated them.
The leaders of Israel brought,
[those who were] the heads of their fathers’ houses;
they were the leaders of the tribes,
they stood by during the counting.

h: וַיָּבִ֨יאוּ אֶת־קָרְבָּנָ֜ם לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה שֵׁשׁ־עֶגְלֹ֥ת צָב֙ וּשְׁנֵ֣י עָשָׂ֣ר בָּקָ֔ר
t: וְאַיְתִיוּ יָת קֻרְבָּנֵיהוֹן קֳדָם יְיָ שִׁית עֶגְלָן כַּד מְחַפְיַן וּתְרֵי עֲשַׂר תּוֹרִין
עֶגְלְתָא עַל תְּרֵין רַבְרְבַיָּא וְתוֹר לְחַד
e: They brought their offerings before Adonoy; six covered wagons and twelve oxen;
a wagon for each two leaders and an ox for each individual,
and they placed them before the Mishkon.
Adonoy said to Moshe, saying:
Take [the offering] from them,
and let them be used for
the service of the Tent of Meeting.
Give them to the Levites,
each man according to [the needs] his work.
Moshe took
the wagons and the oxen
and gave them to the Levites.

h: אֵ֣ת שְׁתֵּ֣י הָעֲגָלֹ֗ת וְאֵת֙ אַרְבַּ֣עַת הַבָּקָ֔ר
t: יָת תַּרְתֵּין עֶגְלָתָא וְיָת אַרְבְּעָא תוֹרֵי
e: Two [of the] wagons and four [of the] oxen
he gave to the sons of Gershon,
according to [the needs] their work.

h: וְאֵ֣ת אַרְבַּ֣ע הָעֲגָלֹ֗ת וְאֵת֙ שְׁמֹנַ֣ת הַבָּקָ֔ר
t: וְיָת אַרְבַּע עֶגְלַן וְיָת תְּמַנְיָא תוֹרֵי
e: Four [of the] wagons and eight [of the] oxen
he gave to the sons of Merori.
According to their work
they were in the charge of Isamar
the son of Aharon the kohein.
He did not give any to the sons of Kehos
because the sacred work was [incumbent] upon them,
which they had to carry on their shoulders.

t: וְקָרִיבוּ רַבְרְבַיָּא יָת קֻרְבַּנְהוֹן לְקֳדָם מַדְבְּחָא:
e: The leaders brought forward the [offerings for] the consecration of the altar
on the day it was anointed.
The leaders placed their offering before the altar.

h: נָשִׂ֨יא אֶחָ֜ד לַיּ֗וֹם נָשִׂ֤יא אֶחָד֙ לַיּ֔וֹם
t: רַבָּא חַד לְיוֹמָא רַבָּא חַד לְיוֹמָא
e: Adonoy said to Moshe:
One leader each day, one leader each day,
they shall bring forth their offering,
for the dedication of the altar.

t: וַהֲוָה דִּמְקָרַב בְּיוֹמָא קַדְמָאָה יָת קֻרְבָּנֵיהּ
e: The one that brought his offering on the first day [was]
Nachshon the son of Aminadav, of the tribe of Yehudah.

h: וְקָרְבָּנ֞וֹ קַֽעֲרַת־כֶּ֣סֶף אַחַ֗ת שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וּמֵאָה֮ מִשְׁקָלָהּ֒
שְׁנֵיהֶ֣ם מְלֵאִ֗ים סֹ֛לֶת בְּלוּלָ֥ה בַשֶּׁ֖מֶן לְמִנְחָֽה׃
t: וְקֻרְבָּנֵיהּ מְגִסְתָּא דִכְסַף חֲדָא מְאָה וּתְלָתִין סִלְעִין הֲוָה מַתְקְלַהּ
תַּרְוֵיהוֹן מְלַן סֻלְתָּא דְּפִילָא בִמְשַׁח לְמִנְחָתָא:
e: His offering was one silver tray, its weight was one hundred thirty shekolim;
one silver bowl [that weighed]
seventy shekolim according to sanctuary weights.
Both were filled with fine flour kneaded with [olive] oil, for a meal-offering.

h: כַּ֥ף אַחַ֛ת עֲשָׂרָ֥ה זָהָ֖ב מְלֵאָ֥ה קְטֹֽרֶת׃
t: בָּזִיכָא חֲדָא מַתְקַל עֲשַׂר סִלְעִין הִיא דִדְהַב מַלְיָא קְטֹרֶת בּוּסְמַיָּא:
e: One spoon of ten gold [shekolim], filled with [fragrant] incense.

h: פַּ֣ר אֶחָ֞ד בֶּן־בָּקָ֗ר אַ֧יִל אֶחָ֛ד כֶּֽבֶשׂ־אֶחָ֥ד בֶּן־שְׁנָת֖וֹ לְעֹלָֽה׃
t: תּוֹר חַד בַּר תּוֹרֵי דְּכַר חַד אִמַּר חַד בַּר שַׁתֵּיהּ לַעֲלָתָא:
e: One young bull, one ram, and one yearling sheep for a burnt-offering.
[And] one he-goat, for a sin-offering.
For the peace [sacred]-offering, two oxen,
five rams, five kids,
and five yearling sheep.
This was the offering of Nachshon the son of Aminadav.
On the second day,
[he that] brought [was] Nesanel the son of Tzu’ar,
the leader of Yissachar.

h: הִקְרִ֨ב אֶת־קָרְבָּנ֜וֹ קַֽעֲרַת־כֶּ֣סֶף אַחַ֗ת שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וּמֵאָה֮ מִשְׁקָלָהּ֒
שְׁנֵיהֶ֣ם מְלֵאִ֗ים סֹ֛לֶת בְּלוּלָ֥ה בַשֶּׁ֖מֶן לְמִנְחָֽה׃
t: קָרִיב יָת קֻרְבָּנֵיהּ מְגִסְתָּא דִכְסַף חֲדָא מְאָה וּתְלָתִין סִלְעִין הֲוָה מַתְקְלַהּ
תַּרְוֵיהוֹן מְלַן סֻלְתָּא דְּפִילָא בִמְשַׁח לְמִנְחָתָא:
e: He brought forward his offering, one silver tray, its weight was one hundred thirty [shekolim];
one silver bowl [that weighed]
seventy shekolim according to sanctuary weights.
Both were filled with fine flour kneaded with [olive] oil, for a meal-offering.

h: כַּ֥ף אַחַ֛ת עֲשָׂרָ֥ה זָהָ֖ב מְלֵאָ֥ה קְטֹֽרֶת׃
t: בָּזִיכָא חֲדָא מַתְקַל עֲשַׂר סִלְעִין הִיא דִדְהַב מַלְיָא קְטֹרֶת בּוּסְמַיָּא:
e: One spoon of ten gold [shekolim] filled with incense.

h: פַּ֣ר אֶחָ֞ד בֶּן־בָּקָ֗ר אַ֧יִל אֶחָ֛ד כֶּֽבֶשׂ־אֶחָ֥ד בֶּן־שְׁנָת֖וֹ לְעֹלָֽה׃
t: תּוֹר חַד בַּר תּוֹרֵי דְּכַר חַד אִמַּר חַד בַּר שַׁתֵּיהּ לַעֲלָתָא:
e: One young bull, one ram, and one yearling sheep for a burnt-offering.
[And] one he-goat for a sin-offering.
For the peace-offering sacrifice, two oxen,
five rams, five kids,
and five yearling sheep.
This was the offering of Nesanel the son of Tzu’ar.
On the third day,
the leader of the sons of Zevulun,
Eliav the son of Cheilon.

h: קָרְבָּנ֞וֹ קַֽעֲרַת־כֶּ֣סֶף אַחַ֗ת שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וּמֵאָה֮ מִשְׁקָלָהּ֒
שְׁנֵיהֶ֣ם מְלֵאִ֗ים סֹ֛לֶת בְּלוּלָ֥ה בַשֶּׁ֖מֶן לְמִנְחָֽה׃
t: קֻרְבָּנֵיהּ מְגִסְתָּא דִכְסַף חֲדָא מְאָה וּתְלָתִין סִלְעִין הֲוָה מַתְקְלַהּ
תַּרְוֵיהוֹן מְלַן סֻלְתָּא דְּפִילָא בִמְשַׁח לְמִנְחָתָא:
e: His offering was one silver tray, its weight was one hundred thirty shekolim;
one silver bowl [that weighed]
seventy shekolim according to sanctuary weights.

h: כַּ֥ף אַחַ֛ת עֲשָׂרָ֥ה זָהָ֖ב מְלֵאָ֥ה קְטֹֽרֶת׃
t: בָּזִיכָא חֲדָא מַתְקַל עֲשַׂר סִלְעִין הִיא דִדְהַב מַלְיָא קְטֹרֶת בּוּסְמַיָּא:
e: One spoon of ten gold [shekolim], filled with incense.

h: פַּ֣ר אֶחָ֞ד בֶּן־בָּקָ֗ר אַ֧יִל אֶחָ֛ד כֶּֽבֶשׂ־אֶחָ֥ד בֶּן־שְׁנָת֖וֹ לְעֹלָֽה׃
t: תּוֹר חַד בַּר תּוֹרֵי דְּכַר חַד אִמַּר חַד בַּר שַׁתֵּיהּ לַעֲלָתָא:
e: One young bull, one ram, and one yearling sheep for a burnt-offering.
[And] one he-goat for a sin-offering.
For the peace-offering sacrifice, two oxen,
five rams, five kids
and five yearling sheep.
This was the offering of Pagi’el the son of Ochran.
On the day of the twelfth day,
the leader of the sons of Naftali,
Achirah the son of Einon.

h: קָרְבָּנ֞וֹ קַֽעֲרַת־כֶּ֣סֶף אַחַ֗ת שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וּמֵאָה֮ מִשְׁקָלָהּ֒
שְׁנֵיהֶ֣ם מְלֵאִ֗ים סֹ֛לֶת בְּלוּלָ֥ה בַשֶּׁ֖מֶן לְמִנְחָֽה׃
t: קֻרְבָּנֵיהּ מְגִסְתָּא דִכְסַף חֲדָא מְאָה וּתְלָתִין סִלְעִין הֲוָה מַתְקְלַהּ
תַּרְוֵיהוֹן מְלַן סֻלְתָּא דְּפִילָא בִמְשַׁח לְמִנְחָתָא:
e: His offering was one silver tray its weight was one hundred thirty shekolim;
one silver bowl [that weighed]
seventy shekolim according to sanctuary weights.
Both were filled with fine flour kneaded with [olive] oil, for a meal-offering.

h: כַּ֥ף אַחַ֛ת עֲשָׂרָ֥ה זָהָ֖ב מְלֵאָ֥ה קְטֹֽרֶת׃
t: בָּזִיכָא חֲדָא מַתְקַל עֲשַׂר סִלְעִין הִיא דִדְהַב מַלְיָא קְטֹרֶת בּוּסְמַיָּא:
e: One spoon of ten gold [shekolim], filled with incense.

h: פַּ֣ר אֶחָ֞ד בֶּן־בָּקָ֗ר אַ֧יִל אֶחָ֛ד כֶּֽבֶשׂ־אֶחָ֥ד בֶּן־שְׁנָת֖וֹ לְעֹלָֽה׃
t: תּוֹר חַד בַּר תּוֹרֵי דְּכַר חַד אִמַּר חַד בַּר שַׁתֵּיהּ לַעֲלָתָא:
e: One young bull, one ram, and one yearling sheep for a burnt-offering.
[And] one he-goat for a sin-offering.
For the peace-offering sacrifice, two oxen,
five rams, five kids
and five yearling sheep.
This was the offering of Achirah the son of Einon.

h: זֹ֣את חֲנֻכַּ֣ת הַמִּזְבֵּ֗חַ בְּיוֹם֙ הִמָּשַׁ֣ח אֹת֔וֹ
קַעֲרֹ֨ת כֶּ֜סֶף שְׁתֵּ֣ים עֶשְׂרֵ֗ה מִֽזְרְקֵי־כֶ֙סֶף֙ שְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂ֔ר
t: דָּא חֲנֻכַּת מַדְבְּחָא בְּיוֹמָא דְּרַבִּיּוּ יָתֵיהּ
מְגִיסֵי כַסְפָּא תַּרְתָּא עַשְׂרֵי מַזְרְקֵי כַסְפָּא תְּרֵין עֲשַׂר
e: This was the dedication of the altar on the day that it was anointed,
given by the leaders of Israel;
twelve silver trays twelve silver bowls
and twelve golden spoons.

t: מְאָה וּתְלָתִין סִלְעִין הֲוָה מַתְקְלָא דִמְגִיסְתָּא חֲדָא דְּכַסְפָּא
תְּרֵין אַלְפִין וְאַרְבַּע מְאָה בִּסִלְעֵי קוּדְשָׁא:
e: One hundred thirty [shekolim was the weight of] each silver tray
and each bowl weighed seventy [shekolim].
All the silver vessels
weighed two thousand four hundred [shekolim] according to sanctuary weights.

t: בָּזִיכֵי דְדַהֲבָא תַּרְתֵּי עַשְׂרֵי מַלְיַן קְטֹרֶת בּוּסְמַיָּא
מַתְקַל עֲשַׂר סִלְעִין הֲוָה מַתְקְלָא דְבָזִיכָא בְּסִלְעֵי קוּדְשָׁא
e: Twelve golden spoons filled with [fragrant] incense;
each spoon weighed ten [shekolim] according to sanctuary weights.
The total of the golden spoons is one hundred twenty [shekolim].

h: כָּל־הַבָּקָ֨ר לָעֹלָ֜ה שְׁנֵ֧ים עָשָׂ֣ר פָּרִ֗ים אֵילִ֤ם שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר֙ כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵֽי־שָׁנָ֛ה שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר וּמִנְחָתָ֑ם
t: כָּל תּוֹרֵי לַעֲלָתָא תְּרֵי עֲשַׂר תּוֹרִין דִּכְרִין תְּרֵי עֲשַׂר אִמְּרִין בְּנֵי שְׁנָא תְּרֵי עֲשַׂר וּמִנְחַתְהוֹן
וּצְפִירֵי בַּר עִזִּין תְּרֵי עֲשַׂר לְחַטָּאתָא:
e: The total of the oxen for the burnt-offering is twelve oxen, twelve rams, twelve yearling sheep and their meal-offerings,
and twelve he-goats for a sin-offering.

h: וְכֹ֞ל בְּקַ֣ר זֶ֣בַח הַשְּׁלָמִ֗ים עֶשְׂרִ֣ים וְאַרְבָּעָה֮ פָּרִים֒
t: וְכֹל תּוֹרֵי לְנִכְסַת קוּדְשַׁיָּא עַשְׂרִין וְאַרְבְּעָא תּוֹרִין
e: The total of the oxen for the peace [sacred]-offering sacrifice is twenty-four oxen,
sixty rams, sixty kids and
sixty yearling sheep.
This was the dedication of the altar
after it was anointed.

h: וּבְבֹ֨א מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶל־אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵד֮ לְדַבֵּ֣ר אִתּוֹ֒
וַיִּשְׁמַ֨ע אֶת־הַקּ֜וֹל מִדַּבֵּ֣ר אֵלָ֗יו מֵעַ֤ל הַכַּפֹּ֙רֶת֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־אֲרֹ֣ן הָעֵדֻ֔ת
t: וְכַד עָלִיל משֶׁה לְמַשְׁכַּן זִמְנָא לְמַלָּלָא עִמֵּיהּ
וּשְׁמַע יָת קָלָא דְמִתְמַלֵּל עִמֵּיהּ מֵעִלָּוֵי כַפֻּרְתָּא דִּי עַל אֲרוֹנָא דְסַהֲדוּתָא
e: When Moshe would enter the Tent of Meeting to speak with Him (God),
he would hear the Voice being spoken to him from above the Ark-cover which is atop the Ark of the Testimony
from between the two cherubim;
and He spoke to him.
